info.title: SpeechNexus administration API
info.description:
Deployment-scoped administration and observation API. These routes do not
establish a user identity, role, or tenant boundary. A deployment may expose
them on a separate listener or route allowlist, but the API itself must not
pretend that hiding a navigation entry is authorization.

Model binding revisions, runtime instances, capacity manifests, and
qualification reports are separate resources. No response exposes private
artifact paths, engine endpoints, credentials, or arbitrary container
control.

post.summary: Create an immutable draft binding revision
post.description:
Creates a new immutable revision in draft state. The registry allocates
the family revision and a globally unique revision_id; the caller cannot
supply either identity. Independent successful commands append distinct
revisions, preserving earlier history. supersedes_revision records a
supersession relationship; it is not an expected-head CAS guard.
Publishing requires separate capacity and qualification evidence.

Replaying the same Idempotency-Key and canonical complete intent returns
the original revision before any allocation. The same key with a different
intent returns 409 idempotency_conflict without allocating a new revision.
Malformed JSON, unknown fields and invalid header/schema values return 400;
structurally valid but inconsistent binding composition returns 422.

An unreadable original result or uncertain commit returns 503
binding_result_unknown with retryable: false. It does not establish that
no revision was created. There is no automatic retry, new key, Operation
or query-by-key recovery resource. A caller retaining the original key
may explicitly replay this same POST with the exact original intent and
key to resolve that result. Without an original key automatic recovery
is not promised; a candidate revision GET does not prove original-command
ownership. Receive refusals do not settle an earlier original-key outcome.

The bounded public ingress may refuse Host/Origin (403), unsupported
method (405 with Allow), receive timeout (408), request size (413),
non-JSON media (415), or local receive capacity (429). Limits are deployment
configuration, not implicit binding parameters or qualification evidence.

get.description:
Reads only the explicitly named immutable revision; never allocates,
publishes, activates or selects a current/default revision. Invalid
path/header/query values or read body/framing return 400. Return 404
only when an authoritative read confirms this revision is absent.
Unreadable metadata returns 503 binding_unavailable with retryable: true
for this same fixed GET. It is not absence or evidence that a prior
create did not commit. Host/Origin refusal uses 403; unsupported methods
use 405 with Allow. No Operation or keyless recovery is implied.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.
Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

requires_complete_reservation.description: True when every stage, including required review or auxiliary work, must be admitted before execution starts.

External_model_binding_schema_json_Root.title: ModelBindingRevision
External_model_binding_schema_json_Root.description: Immutable logical-model binding from a public model name to engine, artifacts, execution recipe, parameter domains, capacity manifest, and qualification evidence. It is separate from any runtime instance, generation, lease, or readiness fact.

revision_id.description: Globally unique immutable identifier for this exact (binding_id, revision). Capacity manifests, qualification reports, runtime instances, leases, submit intents, and receipts use this value as binding_revision_id.

logical_model.description: Public logical model name returned by GET /v1/models and accepted in model request fields. It is not an engine model path.

release_tier.description: Publication claim for this revision. A draft may target production without evidence identifiers; any published, retired, or disabled production revision requires the bound capacity manifest and qualification report.

publication.description: Mutable lifecycle projection over the immutable binding definition. Drafts cannot carry publication timestamps or evidence identifiers.

requires_complete_reservation.description: True when every stage, including required review or auxiliary work, must be admitted before execution starts.

examples.description: File and full-segment review ASR binding.
Realtime ASR binding with VAD preview and full-segment review.

External_shared_errors_schema_json_Opera.description: Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}. This identity is the original execution; retrying never creates a second execution.

External_shared_receipts_schema_json_Pub.description: Allowlisted public projection only. Omit content, prompt, instructions, vendor payloads and private runtime identities. Unknown facts go into stable missing/unknown paths, never arbitrary dictionaries.

XRequestId.description: Validated client request ID or a server-generated correlation ID.

Unauthorized.description: Shared service credential required or invalid.

BindingDraftConflict.description: The original key belongs to a different complete intent; no new revision.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Invalid binding, capacity, qualification, or policy composition.

Forbidden.description: The deployment Host or Origin policy refused the request.

BindingCreateMethodNotAllowed.description: The selected draft creation path accepts POST only.

BindingReceiveTimeout.description: The bounded JSON receive deadline expired; no new outcome is inferred.

BindingRequestTooLarge.description: Actual or declared request bytes exceed the configured ingress bound.

BindingMediaUnsupported.description: Draft creation requires application/json encoded as UTF-8.

BindingReceiveFull.description: Local bounded receive capacity is full; earlier original-key state is unknown.

BindingCreationUnknown.description: Original creation result unreadable or commit uncertain; retain original intent/key.

BindingReadMethodNotAllowed.description: The selected fixed revision path accepts GET only.

BindingReadUnavailable.description: Fixed revision could not be read; this does not confirm absence.

SharedServiceKey.description: Optional deployment-wide shared credential; not a user identity.
